candidates.name: OGC API EDR Part 2 Publish-Subscribe Workflow
verified_facts: OGC API EDR Part 2 defines building blocks for Publish-Subscribe workflows including discovery, topic structure and encoding.
The event-driven pattern is intended to provide timely and low-latency delivery of data updates or update notifications.
semantic_limits: Low-latency notification or update delivery does not validate the source measurement, parcel geometry, survey method, uncertainty or vertical accuracy.

candidates.name: OGC SensorThings API Extension STAplus
verified_facts: STAplus is a backwards-compatible SensorThings extension supporting multi-user observation ownership, licensing, relations and observation groups.
It enriches observation provenance and reuse context.
semantic_limits: Observation ownership, licensing or relationship metadata does not calibrate the sensor or certify a terrain observation's positional or vertical accuracy.
